title: Zesty Wood Chinese Butternut Squash Hot Pot
description: A comforting and light Chinese dish featuring wood-fired baked butternut squash, perfect for a cold evening, this halal-friendly hot pot is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the cubed butternut squash with 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, salt, and pepper, and spread on a baking sheet.
Roast the butternut squash in the oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, combine the chicken broth, soy sauce, minced garlic, grated ginger, star anise, and ground cumin.
Bring the broth mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the roasted butternut squash and cubed tofu to the pot.
Simmer the hot pot for 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the hot pot hot, garnished with chopped scallions.
